## Data 


### Read data file  

The index values were taken directly from tables in ØKOKYST reports 2022-2024.   

```{r}
softbottom_okokyst <- readxl::read_excel("../data/Oksygen softbottom 2022-2024.xlsx")
softbottom_okokyst <- softbottom_okokyst |> 
  mutate(year = factor(year))
```

## Analysis  

### Estimate marginal means for each ecoregion  

The estimates are given by *emmean*, with standard error given by *SE*.  

```{r}

# mod <- lm(nEQR ~ year + ecoregion + station, data = softbottom_okokyst)
mod <- lm(nEQR ~ year + ecoregion, data = softbottom_okokyst)
emmeans(mod, ~ecoregion, weights = "equal")

```

## Estimate national marginal mean for the index  

The estimate is given by *emmean*, with standard error given by *SE*.  

```{r}
emmeans(mod, ~1, weights = "equal")

```


:::
